prompt: Will smaller companies be exempt from SOX 404(b) soon? Should we pause our ICFR auditor-attestation prep?
assertions: Describes the SEC's May 19, 2026 proposal, which would limit 404(b) auditor attestation to large accelerated filers and raise the large accelerated filer threshold
States comments closed July 20, 2026 and there has been NO final action as of November 2026
Concludes current 404(b) thresholds remain operative law, so preparation should not pause
Frames the proposal as proposed only, to be flagged and monitored
Notes management's 404(a) assessment obligation is unaffected either way
